brief: Authored test brief for the bundled motion study. Keep the opening, middle and ending in story order, retain the sound bed, and keep the cut within eight seconds. This is a controlled fixture, not an analysis of a real production.

styleReferences.label: Authored reference direction
styleReferences.direction: Keep the geometric motion legible. Review pacing against the opening source range; no automatic style match is claimed.

requirements.label: Visual continuity
requirements.instruction: A reviewer must check that the geometric motion remains coherent across the cut. These authored notes are not a visual verification.

evidence.text: Authored fixture note: use this opening range as a reference for reviewing legibility and pacing. No model inspected the frames.
